Try itHold the target speed: measure, compare, push, repeat

  • Goal: keep the AV at the speed the speed profile asks for.
  • Every control step, 0.05 s, the controller does four things:

  1. Read the target \(v_{\text{ref}}\) from the speed profile. In every run of this section, the AV stands still and \(v_{\text{ref}}\) jumps from 0 to 8 m/s, as when a red light turns green.
  2. Measure the AV's speed \(v\).
  3. Compare: the error \(e = v_{\text{ref}} - v\), in m/s.
  4. Push: turn \(e\) into a command \(u\), from \(-1\) to 1. \(u > 0\) presses the throttle, \(u < 0\) the brake.

The sign of \(e\) says which way to push. Move the AV's speed (speeds chosen for this example):
